about_the_game:
This is a game that simulates student exams. By calculating accuracy and scores, players can pass the exam and maintain their vitality.

    In the game, players need to collect cards with different effects as possible to increase their scores, manage all negative effects, successfully pass exams with gradually increasing difficulty, maintain sufficient vitality, and ultimately graduate successfully.

    In this game, vitality is the key. As long as you have ample vitality, it doesn't matter if you fail the exam.

    There are 125 cards with various functions and 12 enhancement cards. They can increase your score and accuracy, strengthen your test paper, and help you achieve graduation.

    Of course, most cards cannot be obtained directly, especially some powerful cards. These cards need to be unlocked through repeated exams before they can be used in subsequent exams.
